plain: A model deliberately built to have a known bad behaviour, so researchers can test whether their tools catch it.
eli5: A practice robot that is naughty on purpose, so you can check whether your naughty-robot detector works.
technical: A model trained or prompted to exhibit a specific misalignment (a hidden objective, a backdoor, reward-model sycophancy), used as ground truth for auditing, interpretability and detection methods.
